name: Daniel Macías R.
title: Full-Stack Web Developer
subtitle: Web applications, APIs, geographic data, and games
about-desc: I'm a Central American software developer who likes turning complicated problems into useful, dependable products. I build web applications and APIs, work with geographic data, and make games.
quick-quizzer-desc: A streamlined quiz platform designed to simplify and accelerate quiz creation and management. Benefit from real-time results and detailed feedback for each participant. Ideal for educators and trainers looking to enhance learning experiences without the hassle of complex software.
scanner-desc: A versatile tool offering four distinct malware scanning options, ensuring swift on-the-go results. Eliminate the need to navigate various pages and scanners – stop here to obtain the precise results you seek. Post-scan, download a comprehensive report detailing your findings.
landmass-desc: An image generator designed to produce shapes resembling land and water masses found on Earth. Leveraging Perlin noise, alongside other mathematical formulas and constants, this tool generates diverse landmass patterns suitable for applications in worldbuilding and various hobbies.
cuculcan-desc: A full-stack geographic platform: an interactive React explorer backed by a Go API for importing, querying, and using Central American boundaries and administrative data.
mobookit-desc: A cross-platform mobile game built in Godot for Android and iOS.
not-found-desc: It may have moved while this site was being simplified.
maciwords-desc: A captivating world puzzle inspired by the New York Times' ‘Wordle’ game, with a twist. Players enjoy unlimited attempts to unravel the daily puzzle, each try unveiling new hints to guide them towards a solution. A new word puzzle challenge is refreshed every day!
contact-desc: I am available for freelance or full-time positions. Contact me and let's talk.
